content: Level Six consists of those who decipher the quranic letters (ramz-khwānān-i ḥurūf-i qurʾānī), who derive knowledge directly from the letters revealed to the prophets, without the mediation of rational reflection, practice, inquiry or analysis. Their premise is that speech is among the most foundational levels of existence: it contains all that is at every divine or engendered level, universals and particulars, and even impossible things that exist in no other level.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
